scoring.normalization: Unicode NFKC lowercase; replace each non-alphanumeric non-whitespace character with space; split whitespace; retain accents
scoring.word_error_rate: Levenshtein word edit distance / reference word count
scoring.elapsed_scope: fresh packaged CLI process; includes sandbox startup, artifact verification, model loading and decoding
scoring.real_time_factor_scope: end-to-end wall time / full 16kHz fixture duration; measurement only, no warm-decode threshold applied

synthesis.engine: locally installed eSpeak NG 1.52.0 formant synthesis; no MBROLA or OS voices
synthesis.resample: installed FFmpeg libswresample; 16000Hz mono PCM16; no dithering; bitexact flags; no crop or denoise
synthesis.fixture_terms: New original text and evaluation fixture artifacts declared GPL-3.0-or-later for this project run; generator and data retain their recorded licenses; no assertion that all tool output is automatically GPL

network_denial.scope: actual successful unrestricted control and denied identical loopback canary; packaged model verify, settings and both transcribes ran under same deny-network subprocess policy; no packet audit
